instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Preserve ALL existing React logic, routing params, state hooks, and data-testid attributes in AdminManage.jsx and CatalogPanel.jsx.
2. Upgrade the header of /admin/manage to match the modern command-console visual language of /admin (backdrop blur, deep navy title, gold badge highlights, sleek navigation links).
3. Restructure the 18 tabs into logical category groups with quick category toggles or visual section breaks, using high-contrast pill styling and clear active states.

4. Overhaul CatalogPanel.jsx layout: Replace the flat generic list with a sleek, modern card-list layout featuring rich thumbnail dropzones, prominent price typography, badges, and quick-action icon toolbars.
5. Ensure full responsiveness across desktop, tablet, and mobile while maintaining crisp APCA-compliant contrast across all elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or un-tinted pure white/gray containers.
Keep borders subtle (1px #E2E8F0) and use layered shadows for depth.
Always set explicit hover text colors whenever changing hover background colors.
Preserve all data-testid attributes exactly as declared in existing files.
